correctness.rationale: PASS: For row-stochastic W, rho=alpha/beta>0 and a in (0,1]^n, leader balance gives y_i=rho*x_i²/(rho*x_i²+(x_i-(Wx)_i)²). Scalar root equation G_s(r)=r+(r-s)^3/(rho*r²)=a is strictly monotone r>0. Independently checked exact derivative and identity for logarithmic derivative 3s(r-s)²/[3s(r-s)²+rho*a*r²], giving q<1 uniformly in [m,M]. Nonnegative stochastic W is nonexpansive in log-sup metric, so Banach gives unique positive equilibrium in the box. Maximum/minimum principle excludes other positive equilibria. Jacobian Jx=a>0 with nonpositive offdiagonals gives nonsingularity, smooth anchor dependence, no positive folds. Negative anchors by sign reversal. No ODE trajectory-stability assertion.
